main_text.p: spirituales, vide CHRISTVS Fratres Ioseph descendunt in Ægyptum, Gen. 42. 3. agnoscuntur ab eo, v. 8. Vide IOSEPH. Falsi fratres, 2. Cor. 11. 26. Gal. 2. 4. 2. Tim. 4. v. 14. 15. 1. Ioan. 2. 19.
1. Frater, natus iisdem parentibus: vel etiam patris aut matris eiusdem filius, Gen. 4. 2. & 37. 2. 2. Sam. 7. 20.

3. Homo Israelita, stirpis & gentis ex Iacobo patr. oriundae, nempe Israeliticae, in 12. tribus distinctae: vel eiusdem, vel varie tribus, Ex. 2. v. 11. 18, & 32, 27, Deut. 15, v. 2. 7, 9. 11, 12, Ester. 10, 3, Mat. 10, 11, Act. 7, 2.
4. Frater, iure religionis, seu eiusdem caelestis benedictionis consors atque particeps in Christo Mediatore, Rom. 1, 13. 1. Cor. 1, 26, 2. Pet. 1, 10, & 3, 17, 1. Io. 2, 11, Ap. 1, 9, & 12, 10
5. Frater, iure naturae, humanitatis, patriae, vicinitatis, &c. Amicus, conterraneus, contribulis, popularis, proximus, &c. Gen. 19. 7. & 24. 4. 1. Sam. 30. 23. 1. Reg. 13. 30. Matth. 18. v. 15. 21.
6. Frater, discipulus, 1. Par. 25, v. 7, 9, 10, Socius, Similis, Iob. 30, 23, Pro. 18, 9, Ioel, 2, 8.]
